WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes
)
SELECT s.observstation,
       s.avg_bandusagepct,
       s.avg_bandusagepct - o.avg_bandusagepct AS above_overall_average
FROM station_averages AS s
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE s.avg_bandusagepct > o.avg_bandusagepct
ORDER BY above_overall_average DESC
LIMIT 10
